card.name: Time words like last, day, Thursday
card.fires_on: The word that ends a relative time phrase in news-style prose, such as "last" in "the night before last", "day" in "the other day", or a weekday after "published". It marks when something happened.

modes.label: Relative time phrase
modes.description: Words like last, day, week, or now that finish a phrase such as "the other day" or "just last month".

modes.description: A weekday name right after "published" or "published online" in a news report on a study.
